target_customer: E-commerce merchants and marketplaces in the US and Canada, plus insurers, who embed product warranties at checkout
problem: Merchants want warranty and protection revenue like AppleCare but lack the insurance back end and pricing for every product category.
business_model: Embedded warranty platform with revenue share per plan sold; zero cost to the merchant

founders.name: Manish Chauhan
education: University of Waterloo, MMath in Computer Science
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, researched low-latency real-time systems at Waterloo.

founders.name: Sanket Munjal
previous_startups: Described by YC as a two-time founder; earlier venture not named
founders.background_notes: Led engineering at PolicyBazaar per YC page.

competitors.name: Extend
competitors.what: Product protection and warranty platform for merchants with ecommerce integrations
competitors.traction_then: Marketed to DTC merchants as a warranty provider for the DTC boom

technical_complexity.rationale: Checkout integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce and BigCommerce plus pricing across 60+ product categories is standard engineering; the AI pricing layer and insurance compliance add hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Insurance partnerships, licensing and merchant integrations take time to build, but several funded rivals already offered similar embedded warranties.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Clyde became part of Cover Genius per Clyde's site, showing consolidation among rivals. No source shows SureBright being copied or bought.

market_need_then: Merchants wanted incremental revenue and loyalty from protection plans; the company says over 5 million consumers viewed offers monthly by 2024. Vendor sources put the warranty market in the hundreds of billions; treat as estimates.

branding.domain_note: Uses surebright.com exact match; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Shield-style icons and a friendly mascot on the site
identity.mascot_or_character: A friendly mascot appears on the website; not named
identity.voice_and_tone: Reassuring and plain: 'Product protection made easy!'

branding.community_and_virality: No evidence of merch or community; the press kit offers a logo download and brand manual.

brand_strength.rationale: A pleasant name that conveys safety, but no press about the brand itself and similar names exist. Trust messaging is helpful for insurance but not a growth driver.

outcome_analysis: SureBright raised a pre-seed in August 2022 from Motivate Ventures and others, joined YC in Summer 2024 and reports 35 staff and 500+ brands on its site. Founders came from insurance and large tech engineering, which fits the problem. No exit, shutdown or later priced round was found, and the 2024 seed is unverified, so the story is early traction in a competitive embedded warranty market.
notes: Pre-seed reported as C$3.2M by BetaKit and as US$2.5M by Coverager and Seedtable; one outlet headline says 2mn. I recorded 2.5M USD as the conversion of C$3.2M. A 500K USD seed dated July 2024 appears only on Seedtable (aggregator) and is unverified; CB Insights lists Team Ignite Ventures on a seed. Total raised differs by source (3.2M to 2.5M). Founder surname spelled Munjal on YC. Competitor entries are from 2022 coverage; competitors existed by the pre-seed date.
